description: 한국전자통신연구원_개체 연결 API [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전자통신연구원. 개체 연결(entity linking) API는 문장 내에서 인식된 개체 멘션(entity mention)을 지식베이스의 개체(entity)와 연결하는 기술입니다. 즉, 멘션이 있는 문장의 컨텍스트 정보에 기반하여 지식베이스 내의 다양한 개체후보들 중, 의미적으로 부합하는 개체를 찾아서 연결하는 개체 의... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국전자통신연구원. Its tags are token classification, entity mention, korBERT, 과학기술. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
